easy.q: I'm going to have my car ___ this weekend.
easy.explain: have + vật + V3 → have my car serviced (đem xe đi bảo dưỡng).

easy.q: My mother made me ___ my room before going out.
easy.explain: make + sb + V nguyên mẫu (không to) → made me tidy.

easy.q: I got my brother ___ me with my homework.
easy.explain: get + sb + to V → got my brother to help.

easy.q: Our teacher let us ___ home early on Friday.
easy.explain: let + sb + V nguyên mẫu → let us go.

easy.q: She had her nails ___ at a salon for the wedding.
easy.explain: have + vật + V3 → had her nails done (đi làm móng).

easy.q: The manager had his secretary ___ the meeting room.
easy.explain: have + người + V nguyên mẫu → had his secretary book.

easy.q: Where do you usually ___ your hair cut?
easy.explain: have + sth + V3 (dịch vụ) → have your hair cut; make/let không đi với vật + V3.

easy.q: He had his wallet ___ on the crowded bus.
easy.explain: Chuyện không may: have + sth + V3 → had his wallet stolen.
make + O + V nguyên mẫu → make my eyes water.

easy.q: We're ___ our house painted next week.
easy.explain: have sth done ở hiện tại tiếp diễn (kế hoạch) → We're having our house painted.

normal.q: I didn't cut my hair myself. I ___ it cut at a barber's.
normal.explain: Nhờ thợ làm (dịch vụ) → had it cut. 'made/let' đi với người + V, không đi với vật + V3.

normal.q: Could you get the receptionist ___ a taxi for me?
normal.explain: get + người + to V → get the receptionist to order. 'order' (không to) chỉ đúng sau have/make/let.

normal.q: The students were made ___ the whole essay again.
normal.explain: Bị động của make: be made + to V → were made to rewrite. Ở chủ động mới bỏ 'to'.

normal.q: I was ___ to leave the office early because I felt sick.
normal.explain: let không dùng ở bị động → be allowed to V. 'was let to leave' là lỗi thường gặp.

normal.q: Have you ___ your eyes tested recently?
normal.explain: Hiện tại hoàn thành của have sth done → Have you had your eyes tested? 'got to' thừa 'to' nên sai.

options.A: My boss made me to work overtime last night.
options.B: My boss let me to leave early last night.
options.C: I got my friend lend me his bike last night.
options.D: My boss made me work overtime last night.

normal.explain: make + sb + V nguyên mẫu → made me work. Thêm 'to' sau make/let là sai; get thì lại cần 'to'.

normal.q: Tìm lỗi sai: I (A) had the plumber (B) to fix (C) the leaking pipe (D) yesterday.
normal.explain: have + người + V nguyên mẫu → had the plumber fix. Chỉ get mới đi với 'to V'.

normal.q: Chọn câu gần nghĩa nhất với: 'A mechanic repaired my car last week.'

options.A: I had my car repaired last week.
options.B: I repaired my car last week.
options.C: I had repaired my car last week.
options.D: I had a mechanic repaired my car last week.

normal.explain: Nhờ thợ sửa → have + vật + V3: had my car repaired. 'I had repaired' là quá khứ hoàn thành (tự sửa); 'had a mechanic repaired' sai vì sau người phải là V nguyên mẫu.

normal.q: The dentist ___ me rinse my mouth before the check-up.
normal.explain: Theo sau là V nguyên mẫu 'rinse' → have + sb + V. get/ask/tell đều cần 'to V'.

normal.q: I need to get this report ___ before the meeting starts.
normal.explain: get + vật + V3 (làm cho xong) → get this report finished. Báo cáo không tự hoàn thành nên không dùng 'to finish'.

hard.q: Tìm lỗi sai: She (A) had her passport (B) stole while she (C) was travelling (D) in Europe.
hard.explain: Chuyện không may: have + sth + V3 → stolen, không dùng quá khứ đơn 'stole'.

options.A: I'll have the porter carry your bags.
options.B: She got her sister to babysit on Friday.
options.C: We had the windows cleaned yesterday.
options.D: They let their kids to stay up late on Saturdays.

hard.explain: let + sb + V nguyên mẫu → let their kids stay up. Các câu còn lại đúng: have sb do, get sb to do, have sth done.

hard.q: Chọn câu gần nghĩa nhất với: 'The police forced him to open his suitcase.'

options.A: The police made him open his suitcase.
options.B: The police let him open his suitcase.
options.C: The police had his suitcase opening.
options.D: He was made open his suitcase by the police.

hard.explain: 'forced' → make + sb + V. 'let' là cho phép (khác nghĩa); bị động phải là 'was made to open'.

hard.q: Chọn câu gần nghĩa nhất với: 'I persuaded my father to buy me a new laptop.'

options.A: I had my father bought me a new laptop.
options.B: I got my father to buy me a new laptop.
options.C: I made my father buying me a new laptop.
options.D: I let my father to buy me a new laptop.

hard.explain: Thuyết phục ai làm → get + sb + to V. Các phương án khác sai dạng động từ (bought, buying, to buy sau let).

hard.q: Someone broke into our house last night. We ___.
hard.explain: Kể chuyện không may xảy ra với mình → have + sth + V3: had our TV stolen. 'had stolen our TV' nghĩa là chính chúng tôi đã lấy trộm.

hard.q: The boys were made ___ for the window they had broken.
hard.explain: Bị động của make → be made to V: were made to pay. Bỏ 'to' chỉ đúng ở câu chủ động (made them pay).

hard.q: Câu nào dưới đây ĐÚNG ngữ pháp?

options.A: You should get that cough checked by a doctor.
options.B: You should get that cough check by a doctor.
options.C: You should have a doctor to check that cough.
options.D: You should make that cough checked by a doctor.

hard.explain: get + vật + V3 → get that cough checked. 'have a doctor to check' thừa 'to'; make không dùng với vật + V3.

hard.q: Our landlord ___ the heating repaired yet, so the flat is freezing.
hard.explain: 'yet' → hiện tại hoàn thành; have sth done → hasn't had the heating repaired. make/let không đi với vật + V3.

hard.q: Tìm lỗi sai: My parents never (A) let me (B) to go (C) out after dark (D) when I was young.
hard.explain: let + sb + V nguyên mẫu → let me go, không có 'to'.

hard.q: Chọn câu gần nghĩa nhất với: 'My parents didn't allow me to have a phone until I was 15.'

options.A: My parents didn't let me to have a phone until I was 15.
options.B: My parents didn't make me have a phone until I was 15.
options.C: My parents didn't let me have a phone until I was 15.
options.D: I wasn't let to have a phone until I was 15.

hard.explain: allow sb to V = let sb V → didn't let me have. 'make' là ép buộc (khác nghĩa); let không dùng bị động 'wasn't let to'.
